name: Python + FastAPI
description: Backend governance for Python 3.12+, FastAPI, Pydantic v2, Ruff, mypy, pytest, and virtual environment isolation.

evaluators.name: Python FastAPI, Async Safety & API Contract Evaluator
evaluators.scope: APIRouter boundaries, Pydantic v2 strict DTOs, Depends() auth/tenant injection, async non-blocking I/O, and pytest coverage.

pr_checklist: All Python dependencies managed in a virtual environment (`uv` / `.venv`), never global `pip install`
Lint/format (`ruff check . && ruff format --check .`), type check (`mypy .`), and tests (`pytest -q`) pass
agents_md_rules: **Python & FastAPI Standards:** Follow [`.agents/skills/backend-python-fastapi/SKILL.md`](.agents/skills/backend-python-fastapi/SKILL.md) (virtualenvs only, Pydantic v2 DTOs, `Depends()` auth/DI, async non-blocking I/O, `ruff` + `mypy` + `pytest -q`).

steps.name: Install Python dependencies
steps.run: python -m pip install --upgrade pip && if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip install -e '.[dev]' || pip install -e .; elif [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi && if [ -f requirements-dev.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements-dev.txt; fi

steps.name: Run Ruff lint and format check
steps.run: if command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff check . && ruff format --check .; else echo 'ruff not installed; skipping'; fi

steps.name: Run mypy type check
steps.run: if command -v mypy >/dev/null 2>&1; then mypy .; else echo 'mypy not installed; skipping'; fi

steps.name: Run pytest
steps.run: if command -v pytest >/dev/null 2>&1; then pytest -q; else echo 'pytest not installed; skipping'; fi
